items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: when I went in Russell's band there was no trombone... I think it was Edward Anderson on trumpet.

ctx.x: Edward Anderson was a trumpet player in the band. Lou Henry offered me the job with him; they were going in the Savoy. So I told him I'd let him know about it. He wanted it on a certain date. I was talking it over with Harry; you know, Harry Carney.

Well, I had been working out in Brooklyn all these months, so everything was all right as far as a job was concerned, or the money. But you know, I was losing my ambition. And talking to Harry, I says, "You know, Lou Henry offered me a job to go in the Savoy. What do you think of it?"
